## Linked issue

Closes #

## Change type

- [ ] Balance change
- [ ] Gameplay clarification
- [ ] Editorial correction only
- [ ] Governance or repository setup

## Problem and exact change

Describe the outcome and identify the edited patch entries.

## Baseline and format

Include official version, scenarios, terrain, allies and blessings.

## Evidence and playtesting

Link reports and tested commit SHAs. State sample limitations and adverse effects.

## Alternatives and rationale

Why this change? What would cause it to be reverted?

## Author checklist

- [ ] Linked the proposal and used precise wording.
- [ ] Updated the cumulative patch and Unreleased changelog where applicable.
- [ ] Identified third-party material and have the right to contribute my text.
- [ ] Requested independent review.
- [ ] Understand that merging does not publish a stable release.

## Maintainer decision record

Record eligible votes, conflicts, independent reviewers, reasons and remaining limitations here before merge.
